_comment: Storyboard for the Play Store promo video. Rendered by scripts/build-promo-video.ts — see docs/store-promo-video.md. `clip` names a take in assets/store/promo/raw/<lang>/; `in`/`out` are seconds into that take. Cards have no clip. Keep headlines to two short lines: the renderer does not shrink text to fit. Copy is deliberately close to assets/store/screenshot-captions.json so the listing and the video read as one thing.
